text: SELECT locations.location_id, locations.location_name, SUM(CASE WHEN order_items.is_food_item THEN order_items.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS food_revenue FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."locations" AS locations ON locations.location_id = orders.location_id GROUP BY locations.location_id, locations.location_name ORDER BY food_revenue DESC LIMIT 500
